name: Test Management
description: Plugin #2 (epic #1516, Phase 5): lets a granted agent create test cases, trigger test runs (submit→poll) and manage test data in an external test-management system (Xray/Zephyr/qTest) through a credential-holding broker sidecar. Built on the Broker SDK — the proof that a credential-backed broker is thin: the vendor API token lives ONLY in the sidecar (never reaching the agent, which is why this is a plugin and not a skill), the broker narrows which actions a caller may run per scope, and per-scope resource ownership keeps one team's test artifacts invisible to another's. It is the first plugin to use scope granularity for AUTHORISATION, not just isolation — see `policy` below. Agents drive it with the dependency-free `aee-test` CLI (e.g. `aee-test trigger --plan REGRESSION --wait`).

credentials.description: Test-management system API token (held only by the broker)

promptLine: You can create test cases, trigger test runs and manage test data in the team's test-management system with `aee-test` — run `aee-test --help`. The broker holds the vendor credential and enforces per-scope policy: creating test cases is restricted to the final agent in the flow once its cross-checks have passed, and destructive test-data operations wait for a human's confirmation.
